what: Four plates of the same photo — cyan, magenta, yellow and black — are scattered with multiply blending (top right, bottom, left, top left, widths 75 · 60 · 50 · 75vw). When the section center reaches the screen center, it pins for 5 × the screen height. As each plate’s center passes the screen center and it deepens from transparent 0 → .6, the four gather into one spot (75vw) and the misregistration lines up (.6). Once gathered, the full-color photo turns on (.05) and widens to 100vw (.2). When the pin releases, the picture in the full-color photo shifts to 1.1× and 10% down — a photo studio intro where print plates interlock into one picture.

options.phone: Width when gathered on phones (below 860px), default 86vw
options.grow: Width the full-color photo expands to, default 100vw · none means no expansion (never expands on phones)
options.span: Pin length (multiple of screen height), default panel count+1(=5). One fewer on phone
options.--fx-x · --fx-y · --fx-w: Board initial position · width (css variables). Default is the original values per data-key (c·m·y·k)
options.--fx-ink: Panel color (css variable) — default is print CMYK 60%
options.[data-fx-part=full]: Primary-color panel that lights up last
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photo slot inside the panel — on desktop it fits the screen ratio
options.[data-fx-part=after]: Marker inside the sibling after the part (height 0) — when its bottom edge travels from the bottom of the screen upward, the full-color photo is pushed
